title: 小游戏服务器
description:
The server now supports the functions to create and join game rooms.
这个服务器增加了加入房间与创建游戏房间的功能！
body:
# 🎮 Game Rooms Are Here!

Welcome to the new era of multiplayer gaming on our platform!  
We’ve just added a brand new **Game Room System** — and it's live on both the website and the game server.

Now you can **create your own game room**, invite your friends, and play together in real time.  
No more random matchmaking — you're in control.

---

## 🏠 What’s a Game Room?

A Game Room is your private (or public) space to host a game session.  
Think of it like your own table at a gaming café — you set the rules, you choose who joins, and you start the game when everyone's ready.

---

## ✨ What You Can Do

| Action | What It Means |
|--------|----------------|
| **Create a Room** | Become the host. Set the game mode, player limit, and decide if the room is public or private. |
| **Join a Room** | Enter a Room ID to join a specific game, or browse the list of open public rooms. |
| **Invite Friends** | Share the Room ID with your buddies so they can hop in instantly. |
| **Start the Game** | Only the host can hit the start button — no more randoms ruining the vibe. |
| **Chat & Ready Up** | Talk with your party, get ready, and roll out together. |

---

## 🕹️ How to Get Started

### On the Website:
1. Log in to your account.
2. Go to the **Lobby**.
3. Click **"Create Room"** or **"Join Room"**.
4. Set up your match or enter a Room ID.
5. Wait for players — or jump right in!

### On the Server:
- The server automatically handles room creation, player sync, and game state.
- Everything runs in **real time** — you’ll see players join and leave instantly.
- The server ensures fair play and smooth connections for everyone.

---

## 🔐 Room Types

| Type | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Public** | Anyone can see and join your room from the lobby list. |
| **Private** | Only people with the Room ID (and password, if set) can enter. Perfect for squad-only sessions. |

---

## 👥 Roles Inside a Room

| Role | Permissions |
|------|-------------|
| **Host** | Can edit settings, kick players, start the game, and close the room. |
| **Player** | Can chat, ready up, and play — but can't change room rules. |

---

## ⚡ Real-Time Experience

- All room updates — player joins/leaves, ready status, game start — happen **instantly**.
- No page refresh needed. The server pushes updates directly to everyone in the room.
- Low latency, high fun.

---

## 🧭 What Happens When...

| Situation | What the Server Does |
|-----------|------------------------|
| Host leaves | The room stays open. A new host is automatically assigned. |
| Everyone leaves | The room closes itself after a short timeout. |
| Game ends | Players return to the room lobby — ready for the next round. |
| Private room password is wrong | Access denied. Try again! |

---

## 🛡️ Fair Play & Safety

- Each player must be logged in to create or join a room.
- Hosts can remove disruptive players.
- Rooms have a max player limit — no overcrowding.
- All communication is secure and encrypted.

---

## 🌟 Why You'll Love It

- **Full control** — you decide who plays.
- **No bots, no trolls** — bring your own crew.
- **Works seamlessly** between the website and the server.
- **Simple and fast** — no complicated setup.

---

## 📱 Ready to Play?

Jump into the lobby and start your first room now.  
Whether it's a 1v1 duel or a full-team brawl — the arena is yours.

> **See you in the game!**  
> — The Game Team

---

*This feature is live as of July 2026. Supported on all major browsers and devices.*
